title: Coverkit: Social Studio

candidates.why: Cover + kit names a toolkit of social covers; Social Studio keeps the job noun under Play's 30-character cap with slack.

candidates.why: Short carrier alone; slightly weaker search without the studio noun.

candidates.name: Framecast
candidates.why: Memorable but less obvious that the job is social covers.

audience: Creators and small brands who need matching covers and posts across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp.
rationale: MEASURED — shelf titles centre on Thumbnail Maker, Story Maker and Social Media Post Maker; Coverkit avoids those exact head phrases while Social Studio keeps the job noun.
